verdict.rationale: Flagsmith documents an official MCP Server that gives AI assistants and agents programmatic access to its Admin/Management API through the Model Context Protocol, and a probe confirms the docs page exists. Since the Admin API covers anything the dashboard can do, an agent connected this way can in principle manage flags, segments and environments. Missing for 10: details on setup, authentication and the exposed tool list, plus independent or hands-on corroboration that agents connect and work as claimed.
